title: Uniform stability of higher-order inverse spectral problems
summary: In this paper, the reconstruction of a linear differential operator of arbitrary order $n \ge 2$ is studied by using two types of spectral characteristics: (i) eigenvalues and weight numbers, (ii) $(2n-2)$ spectra. We prove the unconditional uniform stability of these inverse problems, generalizing the results of Savchuk and Shkalikov [Funct. Anal. Appl. 44 (2010), no. 4, 270--285] to $n > 2$.
